laq.question: Discuss distinct, distance, muscles in a structured board answer.
laq.answer: This varies from person to person and with age. At a young age (say below 10 years) the muscles around the eye are strong and flexible and can bear more strain. Therefore the least distance of distinct vision at this age is as close as 7 to 8 cm. Generally for a healthy person the least distance of distinct vision is around 25 cm. In old age the muscles cannot sustain more strain hence the least distance of distinct vision shifts to a larger value, say, about 1 to 2 m or even more.
